purpose: C17 legal dispositions: human decisions about LICENCE matters, held entirely apart from
The separation is structural, not stylistic. A licence decision and a security decision are
made by different people, on different evidence, with different review cycles. One document
would let a record approved for one purpose suppress a finding of the other kind.
A disposition names ONE target, ONE complete canonical PURL and ONE version. It cannot be
widened to a name, a range or a whole target: a decision about one artifact is not a
decision about its next release. The gate rejects missing, malformed, duplicate, stale,
unused, overbroad and mismatched records, and an unresolved licence finding with no
This set is EMPTY on purpose. No unresolved licence matter has been reviewed and signed
off, so none is recorded. An empty set is the honest state; inventing a disposition to
silence a finding would be the failure this mechanism exists to prevent.
